securityModel.legacyCoverageStatus: Historical coverage only, not a deployment gate. protectedTables remains the fixed protected business-table set; it does not require active guard registrations.
securityModel.legacyLiveDisposition: Existing ProtectCandidateCore registrations remain disabled and superseded. No exact count or missing Interview Schedule registration is required; do not enable or recreate guards.

executionIdentity: CallingUser for authorization and business reads; UserId must equal InitiatingUserId; fixed business writes use CreateOrganizationService(null) only inside ApplyCandidateAction.
executionPrivilegeStatus: Accepted Phase 5A/5B baseline: os_sr_cact uses prvReados_sr_cand; BSO direct protected-table Create/Write is denied by role definition. Fresh deployment safety reconciliation must verify metadata without requiring an unassigned BSO role or clean-BSO identity.
profileReplacement: UpdateCandidate requires ProfileFieldMask. Only masked profile values are validated, fingerprinted, and updated; unmasked values, including SDK defaults, are ignored. Masked null clears optional profile values. Required name/email cannot be null or blank.

profileFieldMaskContract.syntax: Case-sensitive comma-separated field names with no whitespace, duplicates, empty tokens, or unknown names.
profileFieldMaskContract.nonUpdateMask: Nonempty masks are rejected as PROFILE_FIELD_MASK_NOT_APPLICABLE; null or empty defaults are ignored.
profileFieldMaskContract.legacyReceiptCompatibility: Version 1 maskless UpdateCandidate receipts replay only when the new request's legacy-equivalent normalized fingerprint matches. Receipts are not rewritten; changed fields or values conflict.

optionalProfileLookupTransport: UpdateCandidate does not infer lookup omission from Guid.Empty. ProfileFieldMask selects the fields to validate, fingerprint, and update; unmasked values, including unmasked Guid.Empty lookup defaults, are ignored, masked Guid.Empty and malformed lookups are rejected, and masked explicit null clears. The offline SDK saturation harness passes the full 21-input shape with unmasked Name/Email null-empty variants and Guid.Empty lookup defaults. One owner-development Console diagnostic omitted unchanged Name, Email, and lookup inputs and successfully persisted masked Phone and CV URL fields; it did not test Guid.Empty transport defaults or explicit-null clearing. The earlier HTTP 400 remains unexplained because its request body was not retained. Fingerprint version remains 1 with tested legacy-receipt compatibility; deployed package bytes are not exposed.

schedulingEvidenceContract.source: Existing os_sr_intv Round 1 records are the authoritative durable scheduling evidence; do not require a separate external calendar system for these Candidate Core operations.
schedulingEvidenceContract.MarkRound1Scheduled: Requires Waiting Manual Scheduling, caller-readable active TA and Location references, and a valid future same-day UTC interval. Create or promote the durable schedule and read it back before Candidate, Status History, and Receipt writes.
schedulingEvidenceContract.RecordPass: Requires exactly one active Round 1 schedule with no terminal result. Persist result, timestamp, and notes before Candidate, Status History, and Receipt writes.
schedulingEvidenceContract.RecordFail: Requires exactly one active Round 1 schedule with no terminal result. Persist result, timestamp, and notes before Candidate, Status History, and Receipt writes.
schedulingEvidenceContract.RequestReschedule: Requires exactly one active Round 1 schedule with no terminal result and a reason. Supersede and read back the old schedule, create and read back the Proposed replacement, then write Candidate, Status History, and Receipt.
schedulingEvidenceContract.CancelRound1: Requires exactly one active Round 1 schedule with no terminal result and a reason. Cancel and read back the existing schedule before Candidate, Status History, and Receipt writes.
schedulingEvidenceContract.calendarBoundary: These manual scheduling records do not represent a calendar event booking. Separate email/calendar integrations continue to follow their approved identity, availability, and fail-closed rules.
